title: Archetype definition
description: Archetypes allow for new types of modular items to be defined without having to register a new item programmatically, making it possible for datapacks or lowcode mods to add new types of items. All archetype items share the same item ID (tetra:dynamic_handheld), an nbt field (key: "archetype") determines the archetype of a given itemstack. Archetype items all act as handheld items, like swords and tools.

id.$comment: Identifier for the archetype, use your own namespace.

honeable.description: Determines if the item can gain progress towards honing.

honeBase.description: The base value for the number of times the item has to be used for honing to become available.

honeIntegrityMultiplier.description: Integrity multiplier values used when calculating the number of times the item has to be used for honing to become available.

key.description: The key of the slot, referenced by modules, schematics and replacements. Should be unique within the archetype but could be reused between multiple archetypes and items.

major.description: Set to true if this should be a major module slot, major modules can hold improvements.

required.description: If set to false, the player can remove the module from this slot.

x.description: The x offset for the module in the item view (used in the workbench UI and the holosphere UI).

y.description: The y offset for the module in the item view (used in the workbench UI and the holosphere UI).
